[[Clare]] is a woman Mat meets gambling at [[The Dead Man's Breath]] in [[Caemlyn]]. She becomes suspicious when he asks about [[Jowdry]] and Mat feels certain she intends to reach for her knife.
== Trivia ==
* Clare is named for Claire Seigneur Pietras, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
